mainText: Good morning. Here is your premarket briefing for Wednesday, October 14th. Futures are cautiously higher ahead of the September C P I report at 8:30. Dow futures are up about a quarter of a percent, the S and P up a tenth, the Nasdaq flat to slightly lower on chip weakness. The 10-year Treasury yield is around 5.2 percent, down a touch from Tuesday, below last week two-decade high near 5.37. Bank of America is down 5 percent on a weak quarter plus a 1.2 billion dollar Treasury penalty. State Street down 9 percent after earnings. BlackRock up 4 percent on a strong beat. Micron and Intel are down over 1 percent, a seventh straight down day, on China chip design progress. Dell, H P E and NetApp fell after a Barclays downgrade. A S M L raised full year guidance a third time but missed on sales, shares slightly lower. Oil is up nearly 2 percent to about 96 dollars on Middle East escalation.
